Today, William went to the basketball court. Between what times could they have gone?
We know that:
William woke up at 7am.
Lisa saw William stretching at a yoga studio from 11am to 2pm.
John saw William walking towards the Statue of Liberty from 2pm to 3pm.
Sean saw William reading at the library from 3pm to 5pm.
Sarah saw William driving to the water park from 5pm to 9pm.
The basketball court was closed after 9pm.
Between what times could William have gone to the basketball court?

Options:
(A) 5pm to 9pm
(B) 3pm to 5pm
(C) 7am to 11am
(D) 11am to 2pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)

From the timeline, we can see that William was seen at various locations from 11am to 9pm. The basketball court was closed after 9pm, so he could not have gone there after that time. Therefore, the only time he could have gone to the basketball court is between 7am and 9pm, but within the times he was seen at other locations.

The only overlapping time period where William could have gone to the basketball court is from 5pm to 9pm, as this is the only segment where he was not seen at any other location.

Answer: (A)
